pages.text: Several mods add the same metal. In this pack each one has a single $(thing)canonical item$(). Other mods' recipes now produce and use it, so only one kind exists in practice.$(br2)Leftovers convert 1:1 in a crafting grid.

pages.title: Steel: TFMG
pages.text: The canonical steel. Alloyed, Big Cannons and Nuclear recipes now give this item. See $(l:industry/tfmg_steel)TFMG Steel$(/l).

Alloyed, Big Cannons and Create Nuclear still have their own steel items, but no recipe makes them. Put an old ingot, nugget or block in a crafting grid to get TFMG steel. Recipes that ask for the steel tag still take either.
pages.title: Old steel

pages.text: TFMG's Heavy Plate (three presses) is the one you make: Alloyed's one-press Steel Sheet is off. Both are in the steel plate tag, so old sheets still work in recipes.
pages.title: Steel plates

pages.text: $(li)$(item)Lead$(): Create Nuclear's. TFMG lead converts. Only Nuclear's ore generates.$(li)$(item)Bronze$(): Alloyed's. Big Cannons bronze converts.$(li)$(item)Cast iron$(): still TFMG and Big Cannons, shared by tag.
pages.title: Other unified metals
Lead Ingot
pages.text: Smelt Raw Lead from Create Nuclear's ore. TFMG's lead recipes accept this ingot too.

pages.title: Cast Iron Ingot
pages.text: Shared by TFMG and Create Big Cannons through the cast iron tag, so either works in tag-based recipes.

$(item)Copper wire$() is Create Crafts & Additions' (see $(l:industry/electricity)Electricity$(/l)); TFMG's converts. Each mod keeps its own copper spool, as they wire different machines. $(item)Sulfur dust$() is TFMG's; Alex's Caves sulfur converts. Salt and cocoa also unify, in Ratatouille.
pages.title: Wire, sulfur, salt

pages.text: Not shared: titanium, tungsten, platinum, mithril and zinc each come from one mod.$(br2)Northstar's Martian Steel has its own tag and is not generic steel. Raw uranium joins Create Nuclear and Alex's Caves.
pages.title: Single-source
